scope: Static implementation-surface consolidation and future execution planning only

gaps.root_cause: The selected connection is constructor-only state and is not persisted with the Redis attempt; public accept/reject/regenerate routes rebuild a legacy default QueryService.
gaps.current_behavior: Submit is connection-scoped, but reject/regenerate can resolve policy, schema, dialect, adapter and execution against the legacy/default PostgreSQL context. Accept normally returns the submit-time auto-saved row, but a fresh accept still has the same fallback risk.
gaps.required_behavior: Persist immutable selected-connection context with the attempt and reconstruct every decision/retry path from that context; reject mismatches and never fall back to an arbitrary connection.
gaps.impact: Wrong-database authorization or execution, cross-source policy bypass, and incorrect user-visible results.
gaps.required_automated_tests: TDD API integration covering submit then accept/reject/regenerate for PostgreSQL, MySQL and MSSQL, including deleted/disabled/mismatched connections and ownership failures.
gaps.required_evidence: Real three-source HTTP/browser trace proving the same connection ID, schema, dialect, policy and adapter across the full lifecycle without retaining SQL or result values.
gaps.isolation: Dedicated platform PostgreSQL and Redis plus disposable read-only source fixtures; delete attempts, sessions, audit rows and source fixtures afterward.
gaps.owner: Backend Implementer then Frontend Implementer; Kimi/GLM then Gemini

gaps.root_cause: Submit serializes executor rows to Redis before column masks are applied.
gaps.current_behavior: QueryService.submit_question stores raw executor_result rows in EphemeralAttempt, then masks only the response and accepted-query persistence.
gaps.required_behavior: Apply masks before any attempt serialization and ensure every attempt read/write path retains only the least-sensitive representation needed for retries.
gaps.impact: Protected source values remain in Redis for the attempt TTL and are exposed to cache compromise or diagnostics.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Security integration inspecting serialized Redis state for masked and unmasked roles across submit/regenerate, plus negative canary scans.
gaps.required_evidence: Value-safe Redis/API comparison showing canary absence in cache, response, history and audit.
gaps.isolation: Disposable Redis and restricted source data; do not retain canary values in test reports.

gaps.root_cause: Session deletion owns only the database row; no cancellation token/state connects DELETE, the running task, Redis attempt/lock state and late frontend completion.
gaps.current_behavior: DELETE cascades persisted rows and the UI delays the request for Undo, but an in-flight query can continue and settle after deletion.
gaps.required_behavior: Define delete/undo state transitions, cancel source work, suppress late success, clean attempts/locks, and emit only truthful audit/history outcomes.
gaps.impact: Work and cost continue after user deletion; deleted sessions can produce late results or misleading audit state.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Backend API concurrency TDD plus frontend late-result/Undo tests with a controllable slow adapter and cancellation races.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser/API delete-undo-delete trace proving cancellation, no late DOM/history success, and clean Redis/DB state.
gaps.isolation: Disposable session, Redis namespace and controllable source; cancel and clean all tasks.
gaps.owner: Backend Implementer then Frontend Implementer; Kimi/GLM then Gemini

gaps.root_cause: Execution timeout and lock TTL literals bypass Settings.QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
gaps.current_behavior: Submit/regenerate/rerun use 30 seconds and query locks use 300 seconds regardless of configuration.
gaps.required_behavior: Use the configured timeout through adapter, asyncio, audit and attempt paths; derive a documented lock lifetime that cannot expire before legitimate cleanup.
gaps.impact: Operator settings are ineffective, locks can outlive or underlive work, and timeout behavior is inconsistent.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Non-default configuration tests for submit/regenerate/rerun, cancellation, 504, audit/attempt state and lock expiry.
gaps.required_evidence: Controlled slow-source API timing with value-safe lock TTL inspection.
gaps.isolation: Disposable Redis and slow adapter; bounded clocks and cleanup.

gaps.root_cause: Quota checks are wired only into initial submit and export, not the LLM/source work performed by reject/regenerate.
gaps.current_behavior: Repeated reject/regenerate consumes provider and source resources without query or execution quota increments.
gaps.required_behavior: Apply the same ordered query/execution quota boundaries to every retry operation and emit one sanitized denial event.
gaps.impact: Quota bypass permits unbounded cost and unequal resource consumption.
gaps.required_automated_tests: TDD service/API matrix for query and execution limits, hostile-before-quota ordering, Redis failures, and no downstream calls after denial.
gaps.required_evidence: API counter deltas and dependency call counts only; no prompts or SQL.
gaps.isolation: Disposable Redis counters, controlled provider/source and audit DB.

gaps.root_cause: The audit lifecycle was implemented for initial submit and reject, while successful regenerate validation/execution was explicitly left out.
gaps.current_behavior: Reject logs QUERY_REJECT and retry failures can log QUERY_EXECUTE failure, but successful regenerate lacks the ordered validate/execute lifecycle.
gaps.required_behavior: Record one sanitized, durable and truthfully ordered lifecycle for regenerate success, validation rejection, timeout, cancellation and source failure.
gaps.impact: Compliance chain cannot reconstruct a retry action or distinguish successful and failed stages.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Audit integration assertions for exact action order/count/context and no false success across reject/regenerate outcomes.
gaps.required_evidence: API action followed by chain verification and sanitized event summaries.
gaps.isolation: Disposable platform DB, Redis and deterministic provider/source.

gaps.root_cause: Process state is treated as health; no liveness/readiness contract exposes startup dependency state.
gaps.current_behavior: FastAPI has no /health or /ready route, Compose has no backend healthcheck, and dev-up accepts State=running.
gaps.required_behavior: Add non-sensitive liveness and dependency/migration readiness contracts and make Compose/startup wait on readiness.
gaps.impact: Traffic and dependent services can reach an unready backend; operators cannot distinguish process-up from usable.
gaps.required_automated_tests: ASGI and Compose-focused startup/degraded/shutdown tests for DB, Redis and migration drift with constant responses.
gaps.required_evidence: Production-like healthcheck transitions and recovery; no dependency identifiers.
gaps.isolation: Disposable Compose project and dependency fault injection; remove containers/networks/volumes.

gaps.root_cause: No current runtime-generated canonical OpenAPI artifact feeds contract tests and client generation; historical manual artifacts remain in use.
gaps.current_behavior: The historical snapshot exposed 60 operations while the static contract and generated SDK contained 35. Current source later added query limits plus liveness/readiness; CHUNK-14 now proves 63 runtime = 63 canonical = 63 generated operations across 47 paths, and the uncalled historical updater is removed.
gaps.required_behavior: Maintain one versioned canonical contract generated from stabilized runtime behavior, fully type requests/responses/errors/redirects/downloads, regenerate the client, and gate parity.
gaps.impact: Frontend raw casts and missing operations/statuses hide integration and security drift.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Static runtime/canonical/client parity and request/response/status/content-type contract tests for all operations.
gaps.required_evidence: Deterministic generation diff with current source-derived counts 63=63=63 and focused browser checks after client migration.
gaps.isolation: App factory only; placeholder non-secret settings; no live services.
gaps.owner: Backend Implementer then Frontend Implementer; Kimi/GLM then Gemini

gaps.root_cause: Historical migrations were not exercised with representative populated states; revision 007 makes password_hash nullable on upgrade but restores NOT NULL without handling SSO NULL rows on downgrade.
gaps.current_behavior: A disposable populated PostgreSQL matrix now proves every 001-009 transition. Revision 007 refuses incompatible downgrades with one constant preflight before mutation, and revision 006 restores the exact revision-005 name contract.
gaps.required_behavior: Define destructive downgrade expectations and make fresh/stepwise 001-009 upgrade/downgrade cycles succeed or fail explicitly and safely with representative data.
gaps.impact: Rollback may fail during an incident and leave an indeterminate schema/data state.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Disposable PostgreSQL migration matrix with local and SSO users, policies, audit, quota, sessions and connections; explicit 007 NULL-password case.
gaps.required_evidence: Revision/schema/data-count ledger for every step; no identity values.
gaps.isolation: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL database only; destroy after cycle.

gaps.root_cause: Repository and deployment boundaries do not assign ownership for browser/API security and cache headers; document title metadata is also left at the Vite default.
gaps.current_behavior: CORS/origin checks exist, but CSP/HSTS/nosniff/frame/referrer/cache headers are not locked at direct or proxied boundaries and the document title is generic.
gaps.required_behavior: After an owner decision, document and test each header at its final response boundary and set stable localized/branded title behavior.
gaps.impact: Deployment hardening can silently vary and browser history/tabs show incorrect product metadata.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Static proxy/app config assertions and production-like HTTP/browser header/title checks.
gaps.required_evidence: Direct-backend and proxied response header matrix plus EN/AR title/history behavior.
gaps.isolation: Disposable production-like proxy/backend; no real credentials.

decision.question: Which layer owns each security/cache header?
alternatives: Reverse proxy owns deployment headers; backend owns API-specific cache policy
Backend emits all headers and proxy passes them through
decision.consequences: Dual ownership risks conflicting headers; no ownership leaves direct and proxied behavior divergent.

gaps.root_cause: FastAPI documentation routes inherit public framework defaults without an explicit production exposure policy.
gaps.current_behavior: GET/HEAD /docs, /docs/oauth2-redirect, /openapi.json and /redoc are anonymously reachable.
gaps.required_behavior: Choose and test public, authenticated, network-restricted or disabled production behavior while keeping canonical contract generation available in CI.
gaps.impact: Undocumented exposure can reveal API topology or break legitimate documentation consumers when deployment settings change.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Settings/deployment access-policy tests for all four routes and CI contract generation.
gaps.required_evidence: Production-like anonymous/authenticated probes with status only.
gaps.isolation: Disposable configured app/proxy.

decision.question: What is the production exposure policy for FastAPI docs/OpenAPI routes?
alternatives: Disable UI routes; retain CI-only canonical generation
Allow only at a trusted network boundary
decision.consequences: The choice affects operations, client generation and information exposure.

gaps.root_cause: Concurrent-session limit enforcement is a non-atomic Redis zset/count/read/delete/remove sequence.
gaps.current_behavior: Simultaneous logins can interleave, temporarily exceed the limit or evict the wrong session; tests script AsyncMock returns.
gaps.required_behavior: Enforce add-and-evict atomically with deterministic oldest ordering and consistent key/index cleanup.
gaps.impact: Session-limit security policy is nondeterministic under concurrent local/SSO login.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Real Redis concurrency tests across local and SSO login, equal timestamps, cleanup and failures.
gaps.required_evidence: Bounded concurrency run reporting only counts and evicted-order hashes.
gaps.isolation: Disposable Redis namespace and sessions.

gaps.root_cause: The detection singleton is documented in code but has no singleton key/constraint and get performs select-then-insert.
gaps.current_behavior: Concurrent initialization can create multiple rows; runtime detection fails closed on duplicates but admin repair is undefined.
gaps.required_behavior: Enforce singleton storage atomically, retain fail-closed reads and provide deterministic sanitized repair behavior.
gaps.impact: Detection can become unavailable or use ambiguous security configuration.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Repository/migration concurrency, duplicate corruption, query fail-closed and admin repair tests.
gaps.required_evidence: Isolated DB row-count/state transitions only.
gaps.isolation: Disposable PostgreSQL database.

gaps.root_cause: Quota database mutation commits before cache refresh, but the API/frontend model only binary success/failure.
gaps.current_behavior: PUT/DELETE can durably change PostgreSQL then return 503; the UI reports generic failure and retry can duplicate user intent.
gaps.required_behavior: Define an idempotent partial-success/cache-recovery contract and render authoritative state after retry/refetch.
gaps.impact: Admins can misread quota state and repeat already-applied security/resource changes.
gaps.required_automated_tests: API fault TDD at commit/cache boundary plus component recovery/reload/idempotency tests and audit-count assertions.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser/API save/reset with Redis refresh failure and authoritative reload.
gaps.isolation: Disposable quota role, PostgreSQL and Redis fault injection.
gaps.owner: Backend Implementer then Frontend Implementer; Kimi/GLM then Gemini

gaps.root_cause: Current-head live provider evidence covers Gemini only; other supported adapters are mock-tested.
gaps.current_behavior: Anthropic, OpenAI and Ollama authentication/body/timeout/model-drift boundaries lack approved real-provider proof.
gaps.required_behavior: Retain deterministic tests and add one bounded approved smoke per configured provider, with controllable negative boundaries where possible.
gaps.impact: Provider-specific production drift can remain undetected; no product defect is currently proven.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Existing adapter suites plus contract fixtures for body limits, malformed output, timeout and cancellation.
gaps.required_evidence: One benign live request per available provider with counts/status only.
gaps.isolation: In-memory credentials, no retained prompts/responses, strict cost and invocation caps.

gaps.root_cause: Protocol logic is covered with mock/in-memory IdPs, not a real standards-complete TLS/network dependency.
gaps.current_behavior: Enterprise metadata/JWKS rotation, proxy timeout, TLS and recovery remain unproved.
gaps.required_behavior: Exercise OIDC and SAML against an isolated real/standards-complete IdP with rotation/outage/recovery.
gaps.impact: Environment-specific federation failures can escape regression; no current product defect is proven.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Deterministic protocol suite plus disposable IdP integration for rotation, replay, expiry and outage recovery.
gaps.required_evidence: Status/category-only auth flow evidence without tokens, assertions, URLs or identities.
gaps.isolation: Disposable HTTPS IdP, users, sessions, PostgreSQL and Redis.

gaps.root_cause: Quota, threshold and enum-like persisted invariants rely on API/Pydantic validation rather than database constraints.
gaps.current_behavior: Direct, legacy or repair writes can create invalid rows; consumers do not share one corruption contract.
gaps.required_behavior: Add migration-safe database constraints or an explicit repair/fail-closed policy for each invariant.
gaps.impact: Corrupt security/resource configuration can bypass assumptions or cause availability failures.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Migration and direct-row tests for negative quotas, non-finite/out-of-range/order thresholds and invalid connection states, plus consumer fail-closed behavior.
gaps.required_evidence: Constraint/repair result matrix on disposable PostgreSQL.
gaps.isolation: Disposable populated PostgreSQL database.

gaps.root_cause: Dev/bootstrap scripts assume trusted downloads, simple environment values and uninterrupted execution.
gaps.current_behavior: One fixture downloads over HTTP, downloads lack checksums, MSSQL values are interpolated into SQL, and failure/rerun/idempotency proof is incomplete.
gaps.required_behavior: Use authenticated/checksummed inputs, parameter-safe setup and explicit partial-failure/rerun cleanup contracts.
gaps.impact: Supply-chain, quoting and partial-state failures can compromise or destabilize developer/test infrastructure.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Disposable script tests for failed/corrupt downloads, hostile characters, partial restore, rerun and cleanup.
gaps.required_evidence: Checksums/statuses only from disposable fixtures.
gaps.isolation: Temporary directories and disposable containers; no production credentials.

gaps.root_cause: Session list/detail and quota status have no response/work bounds; clients request/render complete collections and quota status fans out serially.
gaps.current_behavior: Large users/sessions/attempts/roles can produce unbounded payloads, serial Redis GETs and non-cancellable rendering.
gaps.required_behavior: Paginate/bound collections, batch quota reads, define stable order/cursors and provide cancellable large-list UI.
gaps.impact: High-cardinality deployments can exhaust request latency, memory or browser responsiveness.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Load-focused API and component tests for bounds, stable pagination, batch failures and cancellation.
gaps.required_evidence: Synthetic high-cardinality API/browser latency and payload-size thresholds.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic platform DB/Redis data; remove all seeded rows and caches.
gaps.owner: Backend Implementer then Frontend Implementer; Kimi/GLM then Gemini

gaps.root_cause: The primary PromptInput has no length contract and the public API uses literal 2000 instead of Settings.MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH; only the legacy QueryInput implements a client limit.
gaps.current_behavior: Workspace accepts/pastes overlong questions until the server rejects at a hard-coded boundary; existing UI tests cover the legacy /ask control.
gaps.required_behavior: Expose and enforce one current configured limit at server and primary UI with counter, paste/keyboard behavior and localized sanitized validation.
gaps.impact: Primary UX and operator configuration diverge; oversized prompts create avoidable requests and inconsistent behavior.
gaps.required_automated_tests: API/config and PromptInput/Workspace boundary tests at limit-1/limit/limit+1, paste, Enter, double submit and non-default settings.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser boundary checks using synthetic length counts only.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic prompts; never persist complete text.
gaps.owner: Backend Implementer then Frontend Implementer; Kimi/GLM then Gemini

gaps.root_cause: Shutdown cleanup is sequential without per-closer isolation, and malformed cache records lack explicit typed recovery coverage.
gaps.current_behavior: One failing closer can skip later cleanup; valid JSON with semantically invalid attempt/session data can fall into generic exception paths.
gaps.required_behavior: Attempt every cleanup with bounded error aggregation and map corrupt cache data to constant recoverable/fail-closed outcomes.
gaps.impact: Resource leaks and inconsistent client errors during rare cleanup/cache-corruption cases.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Lifespan closer-failure and malformed session/attempt JSON fault tests.
gaps.required_evidence: No live evidence beyond focused fault tests; resource-close call ledger.
gaps.isolation: Disposable Redis and mocked closers.

gaps.root_cause: Ordinary routes/navigation use authentication only while their backend APIs require query.submit, query.history.view or admin.connections.manage.
gaps.current_behavior: Unauthorized users can reach /, /ask, /history and /settings, see nav items and trigger background requests; backend denies the API.
gaps.required_behavior: Apply exact permission guards/navigation/request enablement for each route and define the no-permitted-home behavior.
gaps.impact: Least-privilege UI contract is violated and unauthorized requests/content flashes occur, though backend enforcement remains intact.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Route/component matrix for exact single-permission users, direct URLs, nav visibility and zero unauthorized requests.
gaps.required_evidence: Authenticated browser matrix with disposable users per exact permission set.
gaps.isolation: Disposable roles/users/sessions with disjoint permissions.

gaps.root_cause: A singleton QueryClient and UI store use feature-only keys; identity/role changes do not form a cache boundary.
gaps.current_behavior: Sign-in invalidates only currentUser, successful sign-out clears, failed sign-out does not, and session/history/admin/schema/UI state can survive user or role replacement.
gaps.required_behavior: Identity-scope or atomically clear all query/UI state on every authentication, failed-signout recovery and permission/role transition before protected rendering.
gaps.impact: Same-browser cross-user stale data or privileged UI can flash or remain accessible from memory.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Two-user QueryClient/UI-store integration covering success/failure sign-out, SSO replacement, role revocation and stale in-flight responses.
gaps.required_evidence: Same-browser two-user/role switch with DOM, network and in-memory cache inspection.
gaps.isolation: Two disposable users with disjoint histories, connections and permissions; clear browser profile afterward.

gaps.root_cause: FR-136 was implemented only as a backend endpoint; the role editor has no client, action, result state or assertions.
gaps.current_behavior: POST /admin/roles/{id}/test-policy is externally reachable and tested, but admins cannot invoke or inspect it in the UI.
gaps.required_behavior: Provide safe accessible EN/AR policy preview before save, including allowed/blocked/invalid/sanitized states without executing source SQL.
gaps.impact: A required admin safety workflow is absent, increasing policy misconfiguration risk.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Generated/client contract, component state matrix and API integration for allowed/blocked/invalid/internal failures.
gaps.required_evidence: EN/AR browser preview against disposable role/connection/schema, with no production identifiers.
gaps.isolation: Disposable role and connection schema; preview must not call LLM/source execution.

gaps.root_cause: The role editor hard-codes the Phase 5 six-permission set and was not updated when Phase 6 added two permissions.
gaps.current_behavior: admin.quotas.manage and admin.security.manage are enforced by routes/APIs and seeded for Admin but cannot be assigned/preserved through AVAILABLE_PERMISSIONS.
gaps.required_behavior: Use one current permission catalog and round-trip every supported permission without dropping unknown/current values.
gaps.impact: Admins cannot delegate Phase 6 administration and editing can silently remove permissions.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Catalog parity and role create/edit round-trip tests for add/remove/preserve and next-request/next-login enforcement.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser assign/remove each permission and verify nav/API access for a disposable user.
gaps.isolation: Disposable custom role/user.

gaps.root_cause: Edit state is immediately seeded from a list summary without policies while save remains enabled before detail hydration or after detail failure.
gaps.current_behavior: An immediate save can PUT connection_policies=[], erasing persisted policies; the existing test waits for eventual detail before clicking Save.
gaps.required_behavior: Block save until matching full detail is authoritative or merge edits safely; failed/stale detail must never serialize absent policies as deletion.
gaps.impact: A timing or network failure can remove row/column security policy.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Component race tests for delayed, failed, stale and role-switch detail with immediate Save and user edits.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser/API delayed/failed detail and immediate-save checks on a role with non-empty policies.
gaps.isolation: Disposable role/policy and controllable response delay.

gaps.root_cause: Workspace optimistic mutation paths remove local state before confirmation without rollback/refetch or visible failure state.
gaps.current_behavior: History/result DELETE failures are swallowed and regenerate failure only clears loading.
gaps.required_behavior: Rollback or refetch rejected mutations and expose safe retry/recovery state.
gaps.impact: UI can falsely report deletion or lose the user's recovery path.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Component/MSW rejection, retry and out-of-order mutation tests.
gaps.required_evidence: Focused browser delete/regenerate failure recovery and announcement.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic accepted results and disposable sessions.

gaps.root_cause: ConnectionErrorCard renders action buttons conditionally, but Workspace does not pass onAction.
gaps.current_behavior: Reachable CTAs are visible and focusable yet perform no recovery action.
gaps.required_behavior: Wire each CTA to select/manage/retry/refresh as applicable or render non-interactive guidance.
gaps.impact: Users encounter dead controls on query failure.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Component integration for every error kind and its navigation/action/focus result.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser action/focus checks for reachable connection errors.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic safe error categories.

gaps.root_cause: DatabaseSelector applies listbox roles to nested buttons but implements only click/open behavior.
gaps.current_behavior: Arrow/Home/End/Escape/typeahead, active option focus and trigger focus return are absent.
gaps.required_behavior: Implement a valid ARIA listbox/combobox keyboard and focus model.
gaps.impact: Keyboard and assistive-technology users cannot reliably select a source.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Component keyboard/focus/typeahead tests and accessibility-tree assertions.
gaps.required_evidence: Real-browser keyboard checks at desktop/768/375 in EN/AR.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic connection list.

gaps.root_cause: Custom dialogs, nested actions and timed status/toast controls do not share a dialog/focus/live-region contract.
gaps.current_behavior: Connection delete is not a dialog, SessionItem nests a button in role=button, and multiple timed messages are visual-only.
gaps.required_behavior: Provide valid dialog semantics, focus trap/restore/Escape, non-nested controls and appropriate status/alert announcements with timer cleanup.
gaps.impact: Destructive/security actions are ambiguous or unusable for keyboard/screen-reader users.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Component accessibility/focus/timer matrix for dialogs, Undo and toasts.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser keyboard/accessibility-tree checks across affected admin/session flows.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic admin/session data and fake timers in unit tests.

gaps.root_cause: Clipboard and lazy-import failures are swallowed or logged without a user-visible/global recovery boundary.
gaps.current_behavior: Copy denial is silent, HistoryDetail logs raw Error, and rejected Shiki lazy import has no error boundary.
gaps.required_behavior: Map runtime failures to sanitized accessible recovery and prevent unhandled rejections after unmount.
gaps.impact: Actions fail silently and unexpected runtime detail can reach the console.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Clipboard/import failure injection, error-boundary and unmount cleanup tests.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser permission-denial and console/unhandled-rejection audit.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic SQL only; fresh browser profile.

gaps.root_cause: History search is client-only over loaded pages and the custom list lacks valid interactive/list/table semantics.
gaps.current_behavior: Filtering misses unloaded results, list errors render in the detail pane, rows are focusable divs without an interactive role, and standalone columnheaders are invalid.
gaps.required_behavior: Search the declared dataset, place errors with their source and implement valid list/table/selection semantics.
gaps.impact: Users receive incomplete search results and assistive technology gets a misleading structure.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Pagination/search API integration and component keyboard/accessibility tests.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser multi-page search and accessibility-tree/focus checks.
gaps.isolation: Disposable user with multiple history pages.

gaps.root_cause: Custom clients cast unknown responses and pages lack a common async-state/shape validation contract.
gaps.current_behavior: Malformed timestamps/dimensions and partial payloads can throw, look empty or retain stale data without a refresh/error distinction.
gaps.required_behavior: Generate or validate response shapes and define visible initial/background/empty/partial/malformed/error/retry states.
gaps.impact: Contract drift becomes runtime exceptions or misleading stale/empty UI.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Schema-derived fault matrix for each custom client/page and stale/background refresh behavior.
gaps.required_evidence: Focused browser malformed/partial/stale recovery, not a full surface rerun.
gaps.isolation: MSW fixtures derived from the canonical runtime schema.

gaps.root_cause: Audit export builds a request from unsent form values and the client discards response filename metadata.
gaps.current_behavior: Download content can differ from visible applied filters; UI invents a filename and real Blob/content-disposition/cancel safety is not checked.
gaps.required_behavior: Export exactly applied filters, validate/honor safe server filename metadata and define cancel/retry/no-partial-file behavior.
gaps.impact: Admins can export an unintended audit set or mis-handle a download despite backend redaction.

gaps.required_evidence: Real API/browser CSV/JSON download and safe file/filename inspection.

gaps.root_cause: PolicyEditor uses raw-string comment/keyword checks instead of the backend sqlglot grammar.
gaps.current_behavior: Quoted literals containing tokens such as from or -- can be rejected by the client even when backend-valid.
gaps.required_behavior: Use a shared contract corpus and defer authoritative parsing to the backend without weakening safety.
gaps.impact: Admins cannot save valid filters and client/server decisions diverge.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Shared valid/invalid cross-dialect filter corpus in frontend and backend plus component/API save tests.
gaps.required_evidence: EN/AR browser save/test of representative safe expressions.

gaps.root_cause: Role create/update commits separately from parallel group-mapping mutations while UI treats the composite as atomic.
gaps.current_behavior: A mapping failure reports total failure after the role may already exist/change; retry/resume semantics are undefined.
gaps.required_behavior: Provide an atomic server operation or a resumable/idempotent client workflow with accurate partial-success feedback.

gaps.root_cause: Routes are eager and have no error boundary; timers/promises/fetches lack one shared navigation/unmount lifecycle.
gaps.current_behavior: Unknown paths redirect, but direct/reload/back-forward and late settlement after navigation are not safely defined.
gaps.required_behavior: Define route loading/error/not-found behavior and cancel or ignore all stale async/timer completions on navigation/unmount.
gaps.impact: Late state updates, duplicate side effects or blank/crashed routes can occur during browser navigation.

gaps.isolation: Synthetic slow/error responses and cleaned timers.

gaps.root_cause: Locale detection excludes saved preference, exact ar comparison ignores variants, and some dynamic formatting uses browser locale rather than app locale.
gaps.current_behavior: There is no production language switcher/persistence contract; ar-EG can render LTR and history/audit dates can use a different locale.
gaps.required_behavior: Lock selection precedence/persistence, normalize variants and pass the active app locale to all dynamic formatting.
gaps.impact: Locale/RTL behavior changes across reload/browser settings and dynamic content is inconsistent.
gaps.required_automated_tests: i18n precedence/variant/persistence and fixed-timestamp formatting tests.
gaps.required_evidence: EN/ar/ar-EG browser reload and date/number checks.
gaps.isolation: Fixed clocks and browser locale overrides.

gaps.root_cause: Forms implement validation, dirty/reset/cancel/double-submit and accessible error association independently.
gaps.current_behavior: Happy validation and secret omission are strong, but boundary behavior and aria-describedby/live errors are inconsistent across settings/admin forms.
gaps.required_behavior: Adopt a shared form contract for required/default/null/server rejection, secret-preserving edit, reset/cancel/dirty, keyboard and submit concurrency.
gaps.impact: Admin changes can double-submit, lose intent or present inaccessible/ambiguous failures.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Parameterized component form matrix and focused server-rejection/secret-sentinel tests.
gaps.required_evidence: Keyboard/focus/error announcement checks for representative forms, not every cosmetic variant.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic values; never retain secrets.

gaps.root_cause: Detection handler validates parseability and block>flag but relies on native input attributes for finite [0,1] bounds and raw-casts the response.
gaps.current_behavior: Out-of-range values can reach mutation through non-native paths; reset/dirty/server recovery is not defined.
gaps.required_behavior: Enforce finite [0,1] and ordering in handler/schema/server paths and expose safe recovery.
gaps.impact: Client/server validation diverges and malformed configuration handling is inconsistent.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Component/API boundary matrix for NaN/infinity/range/order/native validity and server rejection.
gaps.required_evidence: Focused browser number/keyboard/range/error checks.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic threshold values and disposable config DB.

gaps.root_cause: Primary chat ResultTable renders every returned row and has no explicit zero-row state; pagination exists only on a legacy component.
gaps.current_behavior: Large results render unbounded and zero rows produce an empty tbody while actions remain around it.
gaps.required_behavior: Provide bounded/paginated primary results and an explicit localized zero-row state with correct table/action semantics.
gaps.impact: Large results can degrade the browser and empty results are ambiguous.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Primary ResultTable zero/large/wide data tests with pagination/action/table semantics.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser desktop/768/375 large and zero-row checks.
gaps.isolation: Synthetic bounded rows.

gaps.root_cause: Vitest/MSW/Playwright fixtures and artifact paths are manually maintained rather than derived/isolated from runtime contracts.
gaps.current_behavior: Stale permissions/shapes, assertion-light tests, mocked browser APIs and screenshot specs that overwrite tracked evidence can produce misleading passes or dirty state.
gaps.required_behavior: Derive fixtures from the canonical contract, require assertions for named states, isolate all output and classify skips/mocks.
gaps.impact: Regression evidence can overstate behavior or mutate protected artifacts.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Static harness lint plus focused corrected contract/state assertions.
gaps.required_evidence: Temporary-output browser runs with explicit mock/live classification.
gaps.isolation: mktemp output only; never write tracked screenshots/traces.

gaps.root_cause: Generated/custom clients do not accept AbortSignal or client deadlines; local refs prevent overlap only while mounted.
gaps.current_behavior: Navigation/unmount/download cannot abort requests and late responses may update state or create duplicate side effects.
gaps.required_behavior: Propagate abort/deadline signals, distinguish server timeout from client cancellation and suppress all late settlement.
gaps.impact: Wasted work, stale UI updates, duplicate downloads/actions and unhandled rejections.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Client/component concurrency tests for abort, deadline, unmount and no duplicate side effects.
gaps.required_evidence: Browser navigation/unmount/download abort with network and console inspection.
gaps.isolation: Controllable delayed HTTP and temporary downloads.

gaps.root_cause: Auth/provider loading, empty, failure and rejected-signout states are not modeled distinctly.
gaps.current_behavior: Sanitized mapped errors are strong, but provider fetch failure, empty password/double submit and signout failure have incomplete recovery/announcement.
gaps.required_behavior: Render distinct accessible sanitized auth states and a cache-safe signout recovery path.
gaps.impact: Users can be stuck or receive ambiguous authentication feedback.
gaps.required_automated_tests: MSW auth/provider state matrix and signout failure/cache assertions.
gaps.required_evidence: Focused browser redirects, focus/live messages and recovery.
gaps.isolation: Mock IdP and disposable users; no tokens retained.

gaps.root_cause: The reachable /ask legacy decision UI remains supported by tests but is absent from navigation and diverges from Workspace.
gaps.current_behavior: Direct bookmarks work while connection, length, retry and responsive behavior differ from the primary route.
gaps.required_behavior: Choose redirect/removal or an explicit compatibility contract and test bookmarks/back-forward accordingly.
gaps.impact: Two query UIs accumulate inconsistent security and behavior.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Routing/product-contract tests for the chosen disposition.
gaps.required_evidence: Direct URL/bookmark/back-forward browser check after decision.
gaps.isolation: No special isolation.
gaps.owner: Product owner/Orchestrator decision, then Frontend Implementer

decision.question: Is /ask a supported compatibility route?
alternatives: Keep /ask and require full parity with Workspace
decision.consequences: Redirect reduces duplicate surface; parity retains compatibility but doubles ongoing query-flow obligations.

gaps.root_cause: Responsive evidence samples representative happy states and screenshots rather than asserting all dynamic/error/dialog/table/download/security layouts.
gaps.current_behavior: No current product overflow defect is proven, but screenshot-only specs cannot establish reachability/overflow across the full state matrix.
gaps.required_behavior: Add assertion-bearing 1440/768/375 EN/AR checks for critical dynamic states with temporary artifacts.
gaps.impact: Responsive regressions can pass screenshot capture without machine-observable failure.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Focused Playwright bounding-box, overflow, reachability and accessibility-tree assertions.
gaps.required_evidence: Temporary screenshots only as secondary evidence at three widths/two directions.
gaps.isolation: Temporary output directory; do not update tracked evidence.

gaps.root_cause: Privacy assertions are split across backend/unit, mocked DOM, storage and live evidence; no one real-browser run observes every channel through hostile/error/download and identity-switch flows.
gaps.current_behavior: Current evidence genuinely covers sanitized API/UI/audit/export/log/browser-storage/accessibility slices, but it does not close in-memory cache leakage on failed/implicit identity transitions or a joint console/network/download inspection. IS-GAP-002 and IS-GAP-023 prove remaining product risks.
gaps.required_behavior: After product/contract fixes, instrument DOM/accessibility text, console, browser storage and in-memory cache, rendered errors, response summaries and downloaded files with value-safe canaries.
gaps.impact: A cross-channel sensitive-data regression may evade separate evidence slices; this row does not assert a new browser leak by itself.
gaps.required_automated_tests: Security browser integration combining hostile/error/download and same-browser user/role switching with negative canary assertions.
gaps.required_evidence: Boolean/count-only joint channel report; never record canaries, credentials, cookies, prompts, SQL or source rows.
gaps.isolation: Disposable users/sessions/audit rows and browser profile; destroy downloads/profile after scan.
gaps.owner: Frontend Implementer with security review; Gemini
